svg.title: Source-group concentration of squared error
svg.desc: Lorenz-style curves for interference, blur, noise and geometric conditions. The interference curve stays close to the diagonal, showing broad rather than source-outlier error.
svg.text: Sources are ranked from largest to smallest squared error; whole source groups.
Blur and noise errors are concentrated in a few sources; interference error is broad. This is descriptive, not a hypothesis test.
